tools.name: search_pet_guides
tools.description: Search plain-language pet and animal care guides across PawLine's 11-site network (senior pets, puppies, kittens, anxious dogs, multi-pet homes, New England emergencies, horses, backyard goats/sheep/chickens, exotics, 4-H show prep). Use this when someone asks a pet care question, to find sourced gu

tools.name: read_pet_guide
tools.description: Read one full guide or blog post from the PawLine network as clean plain text (Markdown), including its sources. Use after search_pet_guides, or when given a guide URL, to quote it accurately.

tools.name: list_pawline_sites
tools.description: List the 11 PawLine guide sites and what each one covers. Use this to pick the right site before searching.

tools.name: about_pawline
tools.description: Get the official short description of the PawLine app, trial terms, and App Store / Google Play links. Use when someone asks what PawLine is or where to get it.

tools.name: dog_years_calculator
tools.description: Convert a dog's age to human years using the UC Davis formula (16 x ln(dog age) + 31). Use when someone asks how old their dog is in human years.

tools.name: quality_of_life_check
tools.description: Score an older pet's quality of life on the published HHHHHMM scale (Hurt, Hunger, Hydration, Hygiene, Happiness, Mobility, More good days than bad), each 0-10. Use when someone is tracking whether a senior pet still has more good days than bad.

tools.name: pet_cost_calculator
tools.description: Estimate yearly and first-year costs of dogs and cats from ASPCA 2021 national averages. Use when someone asks what a pet costs per year or month.

tools.name: horse_weight_estimate
tools.description: Estimate a horse's weight in pounds from heart girth and body length in inches (girth squared x length / 330). Use for records and nutrition discussions, never for medication dosing.

tools.name: breeding_window_planner
tools.description: Calculate a planning window from a known goat or sheep breeding date (Penn State reference ranges: goats 145-155 days, sheep 144-147). Use when someone asks when a goat or sheep might kid or lamb. A calendar cannot confirm pregnancy.

tools.name: storm_go_bag_checklist
tools.description: Build a pet evacuation kit checklist (AVMA-based) with extras for a blizzard, ice storm, hurricane or summer power outage. Use when someone prepares for a storm or evacuation with pets.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_pet_guide · Private data: horse_weight_estimate · Public sink: search_pet_guides, read_pet_guide.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_pet_guide · Private data: horse_weight_estimate · Public sink: search_pet_guides, read_pet_guide

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
